dedupe_keys.name: 三重県松阪市 指定緊急避難場所 指定避難所 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: 【三重県松阪市】指定緊急避難場所・指定避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 松阪市. 指定緊急避難場所は、津波、洪水等、災害による危険が切迫した状況において、住民等の生命の安全の確保を目的として住民等が緊急に避難する際の避難先として位置付けるものです。 指定避難所は、災害の危険性があり避難した住民等が、災害の危険性がなくなるまで必要な期間滞在し、または災害により自宅へ戻れなくなった住民等が一時的に滞在することを目的とした施... Coverage: 松阪市. The portal files it under the publisher 松阪市. Its tags are 位置情報, 指定緊急避難場所, 指定避難所, 災害_避難所_防災, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
